entries.definition: Creating software, products and projects by describing intent to AI coding agents, iterating on their output and directing implementation in natural language. The person steers the outcome while agents generate and change code.
entries.clarification: In this project's usage, the defining feature is working with AI coding agents, not programming casually or in a relaxed mood. The narrower original usage may also imply accepting generated code without reading it; do not impose that narrower meaning when the user means AI-assisted product creation.

entries.definition: Oh My Pi (OMP) is an AI coding agent harness and terminal coding assistant forked from Pi. Its executable is omp and its package is @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent. In AI-agent, harness or coding-assistant context, these spellings can refer to this project. OMP is an ambiguous abbreviation: confirm its meaning from the request, working directory, repository and environment. Oh My Posh is a separate shell-prompt theme tool; do not silently rewrite Oh My Pi to Oh My Posh.
entries.clarification: Use the full prompt and conversation, project files, dependencies, executable or package names and available tooling to distinguish meanings. An agent runtime, model provider or Pi-based repository supports Oh My Pi; shell themes, PowerShell prompt initialization or explicit Oh My Posh references support the shell tool. OpenMP and other domain-specific expansions of OMP remain possible. A glossary match supplies context rather than overriding the user's intent. Ask a focused question only if the available context leaves a consequential ambiguity.
